objective: Kill the Demon of the Orb, then speak with Tabetha.

description: Ah, a summoner's orb--this is where the taint must be coming from. We must exorcise the demon within it if you're to use it. That I can do easily.
You're the one who has the hard job.  You must kill the demon once I release it.
And you'll have to be quick.  If you take too long then he'll return to the orb and we'll have to start over!
So get yourself ready, <name>.  Prepare your strongest spells and keep your potions handy, and go get a friend if you have one.  Because this isn't going to be pretty.
progress: You'll have to kill that demon to remove its presence permanently from the orb, <name>.
completion: Nicely done, <name>!  You gave that demon a lesson he won't soon forget. You've shown great power and skill. Now I suppose it's time you return to Menara with your cleansed orb so you can put it to good use.
Good luck, <class>. Perhaps our paths will cross again.
